summary: Our (and ours) is a bent flat hand that touches one side of your chest and arcs across to the other, the possessive version of WE.
movement: Arc from one side to the other
steps: Cup a flat hand slightly and touch the thumb side to one side of your chest.
Arc it across to land the pinky side on the other side of your chest.
Think of it as WE with a flat hand.
mistakes: Using an index finger. That's WE.
